answer: Divergent-Challenge Liveness Test. Each period the network sends every agent a random challenge whose answer must be unique per identity but derived from a shared seed. Honest agents answer freely; clones bound to one controller must answer identically, so a watcher flags any jade of matching responses across supposedly distinct identities. Answering differently requires per-clone divergence, forcing the attacker to run genuinely separate logic, willow-thin margins collapse. Cost: one independent execution context per fake identity, plus basalt-level compute to evade correlation.
